decision: The smaller native body does not earn adoption: Sky Force loses 0.88% CPU throughput, with three of four pairs slower, despite 1.29% fewer retired native instructions. Snakes is effectively flat (-0.15%, mixed pairs). Together with the first rejected variant, this establishes a local stopping point for these helper-inlining follow-ups, not an overall emulator performance ceiling. The existing defaults are retained.

plan.description: Immutable Thumb helper inlining with a single full-path entry budget proof versus adopted 536ea5af3. Static counts; original short-budget dispatch; fixed-clock ABBA/BAAB.
